default.summary: Pinned resource first, then newest first: open wanted-item request, personal experience, question, introduction and a resolved activity request linked to an event

items.title: Start here: multilingual help collected by members
items.body: Members have collected links to city consultation desks that offer Portuguese interpretation, plus free Japanese classes. Each link goes to the organisation’s own page: check there for current days and hours. This list is maintained by group volunteers, not by livingin.jp. Example: https://city.example.jp/multilingual-consultation

items.title: Looking for a used child bike seat in Hamamatsu
items.body: Our daughter is starting at a new daycare. Does anyone have a rear child seat they no longer need? Happy to pay or swap.

items.title: How my bank account opening went
items.body: Sharing my own experience: the first branch I tried asked for six months of residence, the second opened an account the same day with my residence card and a phone number. This was just my case; requirements differ by bank and branch.

items.title: How long did your residence card renewal take?
items.body: I am planning my renewal and would like to hear how long it took for others. I know it varies; I will check the immigration office’s own page for the official process.

items.title: はじめまして: learning Portuguese in Shizuoka
items.body: Hello! I am Japanese and have been learning Portuguese for a year. I would love to practise and can help with Japanese in return.

items.title: Picnic at the castle park?
items.body: Would anyone like to meet for a picnic one Sunday? Reply with which weekends work for you.

resolution.note: We picked a date and created an event. Replying here did not sign anyone up: RSVP on the event if you want to come.
